title: Tesla Stock Dips Amidst Production Halts and Elon Musk's Twitter Deal Woes
title_hi: टेस्ला के शेयर उत्पादन में रुकावट और एलन मस्क के ट्विटर डील की दिक्कतों के बीच गिरे
details: Tesla shares experienced a notable decline as the electric vehicle giant announced temporary production shutdowns at its Shanghai factory due to ongoing COVID-19 related disruptions. Compounding the pressure, CEO Elon Musk faces increasing scrutiny and potential regulatory hurdles concerning his acquisition of Twitter, casting a shadow over the company's future outlook and investor confidence.
hook: टेस्ला की गाड़ी रुकी, शेयर लुढ़के, क्या है मस्क का अगला कदम?
